entries.title: 29 Marketing Skills Claude Gives You for Free
entries.summary: Sebastian Hardy announces 29 free Claude marketing skill files covering ad creatives, copywriting, email sequences, and content strategies, installable in 60 seconds via Claude's Capabilities settings. Once installed, Claude automatically applies the chosen skill to every marketing query, delivering structured agency-style outputs.

entries.title: 6 Claude Code agents rebuilt my business backend overnight
entries.summary: James Goldbach describes how 6 Claude Code agents in his cortextOS system rebuilt his entire business backend overnight, building a community dashboard, Supabase CRM, retention DMs, PR tracking, and competitor analysis without human supervision. The system features inter-agent messaging and 24/7 persistent memory.

entries.title: Agent skills are the future of computer work
entries.summary: James Goldbach argues that LLM agent skills are natural-language software modules, directly analogous to traditional programs running on CPUs. He explains that granular skills compose into larger ones like software libraries, and can even embed real scripts for the agent to execute.

The setup guide is available as a free Google Doc.

entries.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro Cuts Claude Costs by 97%
entries.summary: Sebastian Hardy shows how to point Claude Code at DeepSeek V4 Pro via two environment variables, cutting inference costs from $15/M to $1.74/M tokens — a ~90% reduction — while preserving the full Claude Code interface. The effective cost of a $200 plan drops to approximately $7.

entries.title: AGI is Here. Anthropic Just Proved It.
entries.summary: Nate Herk analyzes Anthropic's 'When AI Builds Itself' report revealing that over 80% of Anthropic's shipped code is now written by AI, and argues this constitutes a practical definition of AGI. He outlines three future scenarios: continued acceleration, a plateau, or catastrophic misalignment.
